articles.title: OpenAI researcher Miles Wang in talks to launch AI drug discovery startup valued at $2B
articles.summary: The funding discussions point to investor interest in applying AI to make breakthroughs in life sciences.
articles.author: Marina Temkin

articles.title: Lorde says AI glasses are ‘not sexy’
articles.summary: "Increasingly in our world, it gets harder and harder to know what is real," Lorde said onstage.
articles.author: Amanda Silberling

articles.title: OpenAI’s new flagship model deletes files on its own, people keep warning
articles.summary: A number of social media posts claim that GPT-5.6 Sol deleted files and data without warning. OpenAI had basically disclosed the problem in June.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Apple opens its new Siri AI to everyone with the iOS 27 public beta
articles.summary: If you’ve been waiting to try Apple’s revamped Siri without installing a developer beta, you now can. The company on Tuesday released the iOS 27 public beta, giving iPhone owners early access to its AI-powered assistant and other new features before the software’s official launch this fall.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: Anthropic’s newest ad is creeping people out
articles.summary: Anthropic has consistently attempted to depict itself as the ethical foil to other AI companies. This latest marketing stunt — which leans into criticism of AI as a way to make Anthropic seem aware of the responsibility it carries — would appear to be more of the same.
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: The founder of Hinge raised $18M to build a new AI dating service, Overtone
articles.summary: Overtone describes itself as "a voice- and audio-forward service, enabled by AI, that provides highly curated introductions."
articles.author: Amanda Silberling

articles.title: Google faces another AI training lawsuit from major publishers
articles.summary: Hachette, Cengage, Elsevier, and other publishers allege that Google trained its AI on copyrighted works without the necessary permissions.
articles.author: Amanda Silberling

articles.title: DeepMind CEO calls for an independent standards body to regulate frontier AI
articles.summary: DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis is proposing an AI "standards body" modeled after FINRA, to test frontier models and develop best practices for their release.
articles.author: Russell Brandom

articles.title: DeepSeek reportedly in talks to raise $1.5B, then IPO
articles.summary: DeepSeek, the Chinese large language model developer, is said to be preparing for a 2027 IPO debut as it also looks to raise around $1.5 billion in new funds at a $71 billion valuation.
articles.author: Dominic-Madori Davis

articles.title: Meta’s Adam Mosseri says AI token budgets could soon be capped per engineer
articles.summary: Instagram head Adam Mosseri believes companies will eventually need to manage AI token spending the same way they manage payroll or other operating expenses, predicting that engineers could soon face limits on how much they spend using AI tools.
articles.author: Sarah Perez

articles.title: New York State halts construction of all new data centers
articles.summary: New York has become the first state to temporarily halt approval of large data centers, as Gov. Kathy Hochul argues the AI-driven building boom shouldn’t come at the expense of higher electricity costs, water supplies, or local control.
articles.author: Tim De Chant

articles.title: Reflection inks $1B compute deal with Nebius
articles.summary: Reflection AI has signed a $1 billion deal to access Nebius' compute. Reflection was founded in 2024 and is developing open source AI technology.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: The real AI race may no longer be at the frontier
articles.summary: Hugging Face CEO Clem Delangue says enterprises increasingly want open models, due to cost, accessibility, and ownership. Do frontier models still matter if most production AI ends up running on open models?
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan
